name: agentic-chat-study-hub-docs
_overridesReason: DO NOT REMOVE the zod override. nextra-theme-docs 4.6.1 declares zod ^4.1.12, but its Layout destructures children out of its props then validates the remainder against a schema that still requires children. zod 4.4.3 rejects an absent z.custom key where <= 4.1 accepted it, so every page fails to prerender. Keys inside overrides must be package names only -- npm rejects anything else.
